messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff for release 2025.02.1 — sequenced rollout: US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Initial slices: US 5%, EU 10% (holdpoint), APAC 5% warmup. Model pin: model-v2.3. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/2025.02.1 :rocket:

maya: ack — I'll run the preflight capacity sweep and post results here. planning to watch p95 and queue depth for 20m after canary.

junaid: quick ask: current reserved GPU headroom per region? last snapshot was US 18%, EU 12%, APAC 7%. can we confirm live numbers before unpinning?

oliver: US canary metrics after first 5% slice (12m):
```
US - cpu: 45%  gpu_mem: 62%  p50: 120ms  p95: 490ms  errors: 0.18%  inflight_queue: 420
```

maya: looks good. Confirming rollout guardrails: rollback if error rate >0.5% sustained for 3 minutes OR p95 >800ms OR inflight_queue >1500. Also we have automated fallback to `model-v2.3-quant` for cost/throughput if needed.

lia: flag for APAC — APAC clusters showing 78% consolidated reservation on staging (apac-sg1). suggest reducing APAC warmup to 3% and extend ramp to 30m, otherwise we risk preemption.

junaid: agree with @lia — propose thermostat rule: if region GPU utilization >85% (5m avg) then throttle new slice growth by 50% and hold rollout. decision point logged in release notes.

oliver: pinned a stopgap for EU: added a version fallback pin `model-v2.3-quant` for eu-west-1 in case of memory pressure. command used: `deployctl pin --region eu --version v2.3-quant`

deploy-bot: Canary US passed (12m). progressing to EU at 10% but HOLD if any thermal/pressure alarms.

deploy-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1 reserved capacity breached threshold (reserved 92% > 90% threshold). EU rollout automatically placed on HOLD at 00:34 UTC.

maya: thanks. executing contingency: reduce EU slice to 3% and re-run warmup after 15m. will also enable cache-prefetch reduction.

junaid: adding explicit rollback criteria to thread: manual rollback decision if EU error rate >1% OR tail latency >1s OR queue depth >2000. rollback steps: 1) cut traffic to fallback cluster 2) pin prior model 2025.01.4 3) notify customers.

sre-oncall: oncall here — watching alerts and ready to throttle. If we need manual rollback I can cut traffic within 2m. pinged paging policy.

lia: APAC slice adjusted to 3% warmup and extended ramp. noted follow-up item: request additional standby nodes in apac for tomorrow's window.

oliver: update to release notes: included thermostatic rules, exact commands for pin/unpin, and escalation steps. link: https://go.redwood/release/2025.02.1#ops-playbook

deploy-bot: Rollout state summary at 00:50 UTC: US stable at 5%, EU held at 3% warmup, APAC throttled to 3% warmup. Automated fallback available. Thread will remain open for 90m monitoring. :white_check_mark:
